integrity: The finite map enumeration, full pointwise-order construction, connectivity check, and every beat-point deletion are replayed by a standalone verifier from the packaged incidence data and certificate. General finite-space implications are separated from the exhaustive finite computation.
scientific_limitations: The exact cardinality and beat-point certificate concern the specific 13-point Cianci--Ottina projective-plane model and the four-point minimal finite circle. No claim is made for arbitrary finite models of the real projective plane or for a general mapping-space preservation theorem.
title: The finite mapping space from a minimal projective plane to the four-point circle has circle core
